paper.title: Pareto Frontier of Neural Quantum States: Scalable, Affordable, and Accurate Convolutional Backflow for Strongly Correlated Lattice Fermions
paper.authors: Yuntian Gu, Zeyao Han, Wenrui Li, Zhiyu Xiao, Tao Xiang, Mingpu Qin, Liwei Wang, Dingshun Lv

results.system_description: 16x4 rectangular lattice (Lx = 16, Ly = 4), periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the ACE state on the 16 × 4 lattice under PBC at U = 8 and 1/8 hole doping.
results.notes: Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
